about.text: This case concerns the Federal Election Commission’s dismissal of two administrative complaints alleging that New Republican PAC and Senator Rick Scott violated various election laws. The Commission dismissed the first complaint on the ground of prosecutorial discretion, and it dismissed the second after concluding the record provided no “reason to believe” the alleged violation occurred.
